intro:
# dumb.co Fall Internships

**dumb.co is the hottest tech company in the DMV. Apply for a fall internship and come join our team!**

## Qualifications / Characteristics

dumb.co employees and interns use dumb phones. **DO NOT apply if you are a smartypants.**

No prior job experience or formal education is required, but strong preference will be given to dumbphone users.

---

## Information

- **Dates:** September 1 – December 20, 2k26
- **Location:** Chinatown HQ, downtown DC
- **Schedule:** M–F, 9–5
- **Pay:** $20/hour, 40 hours/week (Graduate); Student: $1000/month and a minimum of 20 hours/week

---
empty_state: Pick a role to see the description.

roles.label: 🛠 Tech Intern
roles.description:
## 🛠 Tech Intern

We're looking for a curious, motivated **Tech Intern** to support our engineering team across mobile, web, and backend projects, and to explore higher-level software and hardware solutions that empower our users to be **DUMB**.

This role is for someone with a basic understanding of programming fundamentals and a strong desire to learn new tools and languages. No prior job experience or formal education is required.

### Responsibilities

- Contribute to features, prototypes, and internal tools
- Read and write code across languages such as **Kotlin, SwiftUI, TypeScript, Bash, and React**
- Help test, debug, and document systems, with an eye toward quality and reliability
- Write and maintain tests to keep our shipping product stable
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams

### Requirements

- Understanding of core programming concepts in any language
- Care for code quality, testing, and thoughtful debugging
- Enthusiasm to learn new languages & software tools (experience with AI coding tools is a plus)
- Excited to tinker, think outside the box, and experiment

roles.label: 📦 Business & Operations Intern
roles.description:
## 📦 Business & Operations Intern

We're looking for a curious, motivated **Business & Operations Intern** to support our operations team with software development, data analytics, customer service, eCommerce, and order fulfillment.

The ideal candidate can think outside the box, thrive in a fast-paced environment, pay close attention to detail, and take on several projects at once.

### Responsibilities

- Contribute to package fulfillment, inventory management, and logistics processes
- Analyze consumer trends and support development of internal tools
- Work with the Ops Team to procure and manage dumbphone inventory
- Assist current and prospective customers throughout their dumb phone journey via email and phone
- Maintain accurate, up-to-date account and contact records
- Identify recurring customer issues and proactively suggest process improvements
- Improve operational efficiency and enhance the customer experience

### Requirements

- You can lift **30 lb boxes** and enjoy hands-on, physical tasks
- You understand software fundamentals and/or are willing to learn (**Node.js, React, TypeScript, MySQL**)
- You have a passion for analog tools and thoughtful processes
- You are self-motivated and comfortable working independently
- Strong communication, organization, and problem-solving skills
- Comfortable switching between manual work and computer-based tasks

roles.label: 📣 Marketing Intern
roles.description:
## 📣 Marketing Intern

**Dumb & Co** is seeking a creative and unconventional **Marketing Intern** to gather, dream, make things happen, and join our team.

Do you live dumb? Are you IRL-first, low-tech curious, and maybe feel like people around you just don’t _get it_? If so — apply for our internship program.

Marketing offline is about friction; we use analog tools to bring guerrilla ideas to life. We want someone who’s not afraid of a challenge — better yet, someone who’s willing to challenge us.

### Responsibilities

- Plan, promote, and host Dumb (offline & phone-free) events
- Execute guerrilla marketing: flyering, wheat pasting, street art, and creative public activations
- Support brainstorming and execution of unconventional PR stunts
- Help document campaigns through writing, photography, or video
- Build relationships with aligned communities and cultural spaces

### Requirements

- Deep interest in culture, trends, and social movements (past and present)
- Background or strong interest in Art, PR, Event Planning, Communications, or Community Organizing
- Comfortable talking to strangers and being out in the world
- Creative, scrappy, and excited by unconventional ideas

roles.label: 🎨 Artist-in-Residence
roles.description:
## 🎨 Artist-in-Residence

dumb.co is looking to host a seasonal **Artist-in-Residence**. We want artists, creatives, designers — you name it. We wanna host u if ur willing to dumb down with us.

We're all for analog, handmade, low-tech art, but that doesn't mean no tech at all. Whatever your medium(s), we'd love to take a look.

This residency is about exploring **offline life, slowness, presence, and human connection** through creative practice.

### Dumb Artists-in-Residence Receive

- Access to our in-office studio space
- A stipend for materials
- A built-in community of curious, thoughtful dumbphone users
- Opportunities to share work through events or exhibitions

### Requirements

- Eager to make art
- Open to experimenting with low-tech, tactile, or IRL-first approaches
- Interested in themes around attention, technology, and human connection
- Attach your portfolio or a collection of works with your application

conclusion:
# Application Process

Email [marlee@dumb.co](mailto:marlee@dumb.co) to apply!  
**Deadline:** End of July 2026

Please include:

- Your name
- Contact info
- Which position you are applying for
- A CV
- A handwritten answer to the following questions: Do you have a dumb phone? Have you ordered the dumb.co dumb phone I? Why are you interested in dumb living? Why do you want to intern at dumb.co?
- (For Artist-in-Residence): - Attach your portfolio or a collection of works with your application

We aim to respond within **2 weeks**.

The next stage will be a **virtual interview**. Further details will be shared then.
